cues.headline: Nobody's in charge now
cues.body: The game has settled. Ball over the last 5 minutes: Elmstead Wanderers 49%, Northbridge Athletic 51%. Neither team on top.

cues.headline: GOAL! Mato Calloway!
cues.body: Elmstead Wanderers score! It's Elmstead Wanderers 1–0 Northbridge Athletic. Elmstead Wanderers won it straight back and the move took 4 seconds.

cues.headline: Northbridge Athletic have taken over
cues.body: The game is going Northbridge Athletic's way: winning the ball back in the opposition half 3 times, forcing Elmstead Wanderers into 3 losses in their own half and winning it straight back 2 times after losing it in the last 5 minutes. Just what Northbridge Athletic need while they're behind.

cues.headline: End to end now!
cues.body: Nobody can keep the ball: it's changing hands 4.4 times a minute. Anything can happen.

cues.headline: Teo Nantes scores!
cues.body: Get in! Elmstead Wanderers 1–1 Northbridge Athletic. Against the run of play: Elmstead Wanderers were in control. Northbridge Athletic won it straight back and the move took 12 seconds.

cues.headline: It's all gone wild
cues.body: The ball is changing hands 4.6 times a minute. Neither side can calm it down.

cues.headline: It's in! Teo Nantes!
cues.body: Teo Nantes finds the net for Northbridge Athletic: Elmstead Wanderers 1–2 Northbridge Athletic. The broken game finally produced a goal.

cues.headline: Thunderbolt!
cues.body: Teo Nantes just hit the fastest shot of the match: 116 km/h.

recap.headline: Full time: Elmstead Wanderers 1–2 Northbridge Athletic
recap.summary: Northbridge Athletic take the points, but Elmstead Wanderers created more.
